# Furnisys

> Furnisys (Furniture Systems) is the industrial furniture brand of Fabtech India, based in Navi Mumbai, India. Tagline: "Functional Furniture Systems". Furnisys designs, manufactures and installs modular, configurable workspace systems (industrial workbenches, ESD workstations, modular workstations, storage cabinets, pegboards and steel lockers) for manufacturing plants, laboratories, automotive service centres, aerospace, healthcare, jewellery manufacturing and education. Every setup is built from standard modules so it can be expanded or reconfigured.

Key facts:
- Manufacturer: Fabtech India, EL-21, TTC Industrial Area, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400710, India
- Manufacturing facility: 22,000 sq. ft. in Navi Mumbai
- Programs: Industrial System; Wall System; Lockers System
- Services: application consultancy, 2D/3D space planning, manufacturing, installation, after-sales service
- Contact: enquiry@furnisys.co (projects), bd@furnisys.co (channel partners), +91 70457 63012, Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00 IST
- Website: https://www.furnisys.co.in

## Buyer guides for plant managers
- [The plant manager's guide to buying industrial workstations](https://www.furnisys.co.in/industrial-workstation-buyers-guide): What to read at each stage of buying industrial workbenches and workstations: explore, evaluate, decide, install and expand. Guides, checklists and case studies.
- [How to Specify an Industrial Workbench: A Plant Manager's Checklist](https://www.furnisys.co.in/how-to-specify-an-industrial-workbench): Load rating, worktop, height, ESD, storage and future changes: the seven decisions to settle before you ask for industrial workbench quotes.
- [ESD Workstation Requirements: A Checklist for Electronics Assembly Lines](https://www.furnisys.co.in/esd-workstation-requirements): Worksurface below 1x10^9 ohms to ground, wrist strap system below 3.5x10^7 ohms, one common grounding point, insulator control and daily checks, per ANSI/ESD S20.20 and IEC 61340-5-1; what to ask suppliers.
- [Workbench vs Workstation: What's the Difference?](https://www.furnisys.co.in/workbench-vs-workstation): A workbench is the surface you work on; a workstation is a bench built out for one task. How to tell which your line needs, with examples.
- [Industrial Workstation RFQ Checklist: What to Send Suppliers and How to Compare Quotes](https://www.furnisys.co.in/industrial-workstation-rfq-checklist): What to send suppliers when you buy industrial workbenches and workstations, what to ask every one of them for, and how to compare the quotes fairly.
